note: The header of a photo_index JPEG holding a second XMP packet inside its EXIF (IFD0 tag 0x02BC, ApplicationNotes), as Windows Live Photo Gallery wrote it, captured read-only 2026-11-16 (#3108; read by tests/test_a_photo_written_by_its_own_editors.py). 'tiff' is the EXIF block's TIFF bytes after 'Exif\0\0', 'tiff_size' long, given as its runs of non-zero bytes [offset, hex]: every other byte is zero. The IFD0 packet is 'ifd0_packet', at 'ifd0_packet_at' of the TIFF bytes (the 0x02BC entry's value, the same length); the APP1 packet is 'xmp', its padding 'xmp_padding' spaces before '<?xpacket end'. Every keyword, name, title, comment and person region's text is replaced by a fictional value of the same shape and length, every date by one fictional instant; the thumbnail's bytes are zero and the APP1 packet's TagPup bake description (face embeddings) is left out. The ICC profile segment the photo also held is not kept.
